name: Southmoon Ruins
summary: Dunemaul ogres camp among the Southmoon Ruins in southern Tanaris, north of the Valley of the Watchers. Their stones preserve the remains of an ancient troll civilization that once ruled the desert.

sections.title: Stones in the Shifting Sands
sections.body: Weathered pillars and altars rise from the sands at Southmoon in southern Tanaris. Nearby Eastmoon and Noonshade share their age, their stones worn by thousands of years of wind and grit. Dunemaul ogres have often camped among these old structures. They claim the stones for shelter and territory, with little regard for the craft that shaped them.

sections.title: Secrets Beneath the Rubble
sections.body: Southmoon’s stones are unmistakably trollish, though little is recorded of who raised them or why they left. Whatever remains lies beneath the drifting sand. The Dunemaul ogres camp among the pillars without concern for it.

faq.q: Who originally built the Southmoon Ruins?
faq.answer: The Southmoon Ruins preserve remnants of the ancient troll civilization that once held the southern reaches of what is now the Tanaris desert.
Dunemaul ogres traditionally inhabit the ruins. They wandered into Tanaris, claimed crumbling ancient outposts as camps, and drove off other scavengers.

faq.q: Where are the Southmoon Ruins located?
faq.answer: The Southmoon Ruins lie in southern Tanaris, northwest of the Valley of the Watchers and south of the central desert wastes.

angles.text: As a dwarf crossing southern Tanaris, you find weathered troll stonework at Southmoon, with Dunemaul ogres camped among it.
As a Darkspear troll, you see the fallen grandeur of distant troll cousins in these broken columns, now reduced to squalor beneath the desert sun.
